items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury; will miss at least four games (next eligibility ~Week 9 due to bye). No surgery needed.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 3; coach confirms at least 4 weeks.

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (groin/hip) to play Sunday vs Eagles; slated/full practice progress reported.
items.why: McVay comments; full practice reports and GMFB confirmation.
items.implication: WR1 volume returns; Adams/Higbee share drops.
items.opportunity: High target share, routes as lead WR

items.text: Little optimism Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; sidelined this week, expectation he won't go.
items.why: Sources to Schefter/Garafolo; no practice optimism.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thins opposite Nacua return; more to Goedert/Brown if healthy.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren (TNF vs CLE): 90% snap rate last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game. Top-10 play.
items.why: Elite recent usage + matchup + Dowdle OUT again.

items.text: Ravens Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers among those upgraded to full on Thursday injury report.
items.implication: Clear for Week 4; full offensive firepower.
items.opportunity: Normal high usage/routes for Flowers; dual-threat Lamar

items.text: LOVE Drake London (@ NO): 35% career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share last week (9-194). NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.opportunity: Massive target share, routes with Penix

items.text: No practice Wednesday for WR Justin Jefferson (ankle); team considers day-to-day.
items.opportunity: If out, Addison primary target share

items.text: ETR fresh ROS Top-150 ranks Kenneth Walker #3 overall (notable riser); also high on Parker Washington #22, Saquon #30.
items.why: Post-Week 3 role/usage/schedule evaluation; Charbonnet return noted but Walker prioritized.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries with Charbonnet still ramping

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed placed on IR; will undergo season-ending neck surgery. Out indefinitely/season.
items.implication: GB WR corps reshuffle; more for Watson/Wicks/Golden.

items.text: Pat Thorman Week 4 rankings live; snaps & pace notes: DAL@HOU up in pace, LAC@SEA slow slog. Full usage focus.
items.why: Weekly snaps-pace and rankings update post-Week 3.
items.implication: Pace/environment edges for DAL/HOU players; fade slow games.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson (Mitchell out, 36% prior share), Josh Downs (31% targets/43% RZ), George Kittle (climbing share, Evans DTD), Trevor Lawrence (high total, history vs CIN).
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes/RZ for WRs/TE; pass volume for Lawrence

items.text: HATE Justin Herbert (@SEA pressure/low YPA), Omarion Hampton (low snaps/routes/target share vs stout SEA run D), Kyle Pitts (low share with Penix), Emeka Egbuka (new QB, low RZ, low total), Xavier Worthy (shrinking share vs Rice).
items.why: Usage drops, tough matchups, QB/role issues.
items.conflict: Levitan also flags Pitts low opportunity

items.text: Seahawks designated RB Zach Charbonnet to return to practice (from IR/PUP).
items.why: Official designation; not expected this week but 21-day window opens.
items.implication: Potential return in 1-3 weeks; impacts Walker/Price/others long-term.
items.opportunity: Future committee threat to Kenneth Walker

items.text: Kyle Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT; among worst results relative to opportunity this season.
items.why: Actual opportunity data vs production; chart of underperformers.
items.implication: Fade/start low; Penix connection not producing.
items.opportunity: Low RZ/third-down share despite TE role
